name: ph-corporate-income-tax
description: Philippine corporate income tax for 2026: classify a domestic, resident foreign or nonresident foreign corporation, establish its taxable-income base, test the smaller-domestic-company rate and minimum corporate income tax, and separate final-taxed passive receipts from ordinary taxable income. Covers corporate OSD, domestic intercorporate dividends, nonresident dividend withholding and tax sparing, CMEPA deposit-interest transition rules, passive royalties, branch profit remittances, annual corporate returns and quarterly payments. Use for a company tax computation or a dividend/remittance review. Incentivised registered projects, treaties and special corporate regimes require their own documented eligibility analysis before applying a concession.
